dct_title_s: USGS NHDPlus High Resolution (NHDPlus HR) for the United States, Release 2
dct_description_sm: The National Hydrography Dataset Plus High Resolution (NHDPlus HR) National Release 2 (NR2) is an update to National Hydrography Dataset Plus High Resolution National Release 1 (NR1), which was published in July 2022. NR2 contains updated data for hydrographic regions 01, 02, 14, 15, and 16, and newly produced data for seven 8-digit Hydrologic Units in Alaska. Data for all other areas is included in NR2 but is unchanged from NR1.

NHDPlus HR is an integrated set of geospatial data layers, including the National Hydrography Dataset (NHD), National Watershed Boundary Dataset (WBD), and 3D Elevation Program Digital Elevation Model (3DEP DEM). The NHDPlus HR combines the NHD, 3DEP digital elevation models, and WBD to a data suite that includes the NHD stream network with linear referencing functionality, the WBD hydrologic units, elevation-derived catchment areas for each stream segment, value-added attributes (VAAs), and other features that enhance hydrologic data analysis and routing.

The NHDPlus HR National Release data is an aggregated, continuous, national extent (except for much of Alaska) dataset comprised of all the NHDPlus HR HU4 or HU8 VPU staged products. The dataset uses a simplified NHDPlus HR National Data Model that includes aggregations of selected vector data from the NHDPlus HR Vector Processing Unit (VPU) Data Model, plus two additional tables and two additional national feature classes that are not included in the VPU Data Model. Only NHDPlus HR vector data is included—none of the raster data is included.

Although data for region 06 (VPUs 0601, 0602, 0603, and 0604) has been updated and is available as individual VPU datasets, those data were not included in this national aggregation because of errors that disconnected the Tennessee River from the Ohio River, leaving the entire region isolated and disconnected. The initial “Beta” release of these VPUs is used instead in this dataset.

Because adjacent VPUs often contained duplicate copies of features intersecting the VPU boundaries, there are multiple copies of some features in this national aggregation. These features in general were assigned unique NHDPlusID values, and thus are not complete duplicates, though in many cases all other attribute values and geometry are the same.
Additional documentation for the NHDPlus HR is available in a User Guide, available here: https://pubs.usgs.gov/publication/ofr20191096
An updated version of this dataset was posted on 19-Aug-2025 to address a corrupted file affecting catchments rendering.
